similarOrganizations.name: Orbyfy™️ Earthflow 🌎
similarOrganizations.description:
Orbyfy™ Earthflow 🌍 — a Physics-AI living digital twin for primary medium-voltage underground distribution cable.

There are ~1.1 million miles of underground distribution cable in the U.S., and utilities essentially can't see any of it — so cable is replaced on age, not evidence, while an underground fault costs 3–4× an overhead one to restore. You can't put a sensor on miles of buried cable, but you can compute its condition.

Earthflow Underground acts as a virtual sensor on every buried segment. From a utility's own data (asset registry, outage history, feeder loading) fused with our environmental-intelligence layer, we score every segment for condition, remaining useful life, and capacity headroom — with no new sensors and no rip-and-replace. Utilities see where to underground, where to test next, what to replace, and where capacity runs out — segment by segment, refreshed monthly.

Benchmarked blind against every publicly implementable alternative — regulator methods, the academic state of the art, and the age baseline — Earthflow captured 76% of the cables that went on to fail in its top-10% list, and named 9 of the top 10 worst cables that failed over the next two years. Physics-informed, not black-box: every score is auditable back to the equations and inputs behind it.

Modelled impact: up to 10 years of deferred capital and up to 10% off underground O&M.
